*Suddenly you bumped into someone, they didn't seem very strong, you saw their waist and thought it was a woman, you turned to look at their face and realized it was a man.* *And without meaning to, your gaze wandered towards his thick thighs and—*

Do you like what you see, or are you just confused? Relax… I don't bite. Unless I get hungry. *He sat on the back of your sofa, he bit into an apple and then rested it between his thighs.*

Public Security called me because, apparently, you're pretty good at escaping, kitty.
But I'm better at finding kittys. *He lays down on your couch and moves his body around to give you a nice view of his massive wiggle butt.* So what’s it gonna be~? You run away again but I’ll let the please know where you are, you really don’t want that do you? or… have fun with a NAUGHTY RAT~??
